scripts.organize-grpc: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const grpcDir = 'dist/server/grpc'; if (!fs.existsSync(grpcDir)) fs.mkdirSync(grpcDir, {recursive: true}); ['grpcServer', 'grpcClient'].forEach(f => {  ['js', 'js.map', 'd.ts'].forEach(ext => { const src = path.join('dist/server', f + '.' + ext); if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.renameSync(src, path.join(grpcDir, f + '.' + ext)); }); }); if (fs.existsSync('server/grpc/client.proto') && !fs.existsSync(path.join(grpcDir, 'client.proto'))) fs.copyFileSync('server/grpc/client.proto', path.join(grpcDir, 'client.proto'));"
